requirements.Title: AI Productivity, Scan Workflow & Manageability Solutions
requirements.Description: Integrate advanced AI-driven productivity features, scan workflow automation, and manageability solutions into the Magellan printer to simplify business operations for SMBs.
requirements.Rationale: Target SMBs demand efficiency and minimal IT intervention. AI features and manageability are key differentiators for Magellan.
requirements.Stakeholders: Marketing, GXD, Quality, R&D Telemetry, Supplies Quality, DVAR, Tech Reg, Prod Steward, BA
requirements.Dependencies: Requires AI software integration and compatible hardware.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Magellan printer delivers AI-powered scan and print workflows; centralized management portal is functional and accessible for SMB users.

requirements.Title: Lowest Business TCO (Total Cost of Ownership)
requirements.Description: Design Magellan to deliver HP’s lowest business TCO through optimized ink usage, minimal maintenance, and efficient consumables.
requirements.Rationale: SMBs are highly cost-sensitive and seek maximum ROI; low TCO is a major purchase driver.
requirements.Dependencies: Requires efficient ink tank system and durable components.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Independent testing confirms Magellan has the lowest TCO in its class compared to competitors.

requirements.Title: Customer-Replaceable Maintenance Box
requirements.Description: Enable the maintenance box to be easily replaceable by customers without technical support.
requirements.Rationale: Target SMBs lack dedicated IT support; easy maintenance reduces downtime and support costs.
requirements.Stakeholders: Quality, R&D Telemetry, DVAR, Tech Reg, Prod Steward
requirements.Dependencies: Design for tool-less replacement and clear instructions.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: User can replace maintenance box within 5 minutes using included instructions, with no tools required.

requirements.Title: Serviceability: PHA and MINK at Service Centre
requirements.Description: Implement serviceability protocols: PHA (customer replaceable) and MINK (service center replaceable) for key components, prioritizing customer replaceable where possible.
requirements.Rationale: Reduces service costs and downtime for SMBs, aligning with limited IT resources.
requirements.Stakeholders: Quality, DVAR, Tech Reg, Prod Steward
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: At least 80% of serviceable parts are customer-replaceable; others are service center replaceable.

requirements.Title: Keyed Bottles for Ink Refilling
requirements.Description: Design ink bottles with unique keying to prevent misfilling and ensure proper use with Magellan printers.
requirements.Rationale: Prevents user error, reduces support calls, and protects printer integrity.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Only correct bottle fits the corresponding tank; user testing shows zero misfills in 100 attempts.

requirements.Title: Non-PDL SKU: SMB2.0 Solutions and Advanced View SMB Portal
requirements.Description: Offer a non-PDL SKU that supports SMB2.0 solutions and integrates with the Advanced View SMB portal for device management.
requirements.Rationale: Addresses needs of unmanaged/lightly managed SMBs for centralized management without complex IT.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Non-PDL SKU ships with SMB2.0 and portal access enabled; portal manages all connected devices.

requirements.Title: PDL SKU: Higher Print Speeds and PDL/PS Support
requirements.Description: Provide a PDL SKU with improved print speeds (target 25/20 ppm) and support for PDL/PS (Page Description Language/PostScript).
requirements.Rationale: Meets business needs for faster printing and compatibility with advanced workflows.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: PDL SKU achieves 25/20 ppm; passes compatibility tests with PDL/PS workflows.

requirements.Title: Blue Angel Certification for PDL SKU
requirements.Description: Ensure the PDL SKU meets Blue Angel environmental certification requirements.
requirements.Rationale: Environmental compliance is increasingly required in tenders and valued by SMBs.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: PDL SKU receives Blue Angel certification prior to launch.

requirements.Title: First OJ Pro with Ink Tanks
requirements.Description: Magellan to be the first HP OfficeJet Pro product with ink tank technology, targeting CISS PLE Hi segment.
requirements.Rationale: Fills a gap in HP’s portfolio and addresses market shift toward CISS in SMB segment.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Product is launched as HP’s first OJ Pro with ink tanks; marketing materials reflect this.

requirements.Title: Perfect Print and Perfect Scan AI Solutions
requirements.Description: Incorporate AI-powered features for optimal print and scan quality, including error correction and workflow automation.
requirements.Rationale: AI features differentiate Magellan and address SMB needs for efficiency and quality.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: AI-driven print/scan features demonstrably improve quality and reduce errors in independent tests.

requirements.Title: Consolidated SMB Portal for Device Management
requirements.Description: Develop a consolidated portal for SMBs to manage all Magellan printers and related devices from a single interface.
requirements.Rationale: Simplifies device management for businesses without dedicated IT.
requirements.Dependencies: Portal software development and cloud infrastructure.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Portal enables registration, monitoring, and management of all connected devices; user satisfaction >90% in pilot.

requirements.Title: Maintenance-Free or Less Maintenance Design
requirements.Description: Engineer Magellan for maintenance-free or minimal maintenance operation, with fewer parts requiring replacement over product life.
requirements.Rationale: Reduces operational burden and cost for SMBs with little IT support.
requirements.Stakeholders: Quality, Prod Steward, Tech Reg, DVAR
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Over 80% of units require no major maintenance during 2-year warranty period.

requirements.Title: Sustainability: 60% Recycled Content Plastic (RCP)
requirements.Description: Magellan to be manufactured using at least 60% recycled content plastic, exceeding competitors’ sustainability benchmarks.
requirements.Rationale: Addresses growing customer and regulatory demand for sustainable products.
requirements.Stakeholders: Prod Steward, Tech Reg, Marketing, Quality
requirements.Dependencies: Supply chain readiness and material sourcing.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Bill of materials and certification confirm 60% RCP in all relevant parts.

requirements.Title: Mobile Printing via HP App
requirements.Description: Enable seamless mobile printing capabilities through the HP App for Magellan users.
requirements.Rationale: Supports modern SMB workflows and BYOD environments.
requirements.Dependencies: App integration and printer firmware support.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Users can print from mobile devices via HP App with >95% success rate in testing.

requirements.Title: PaaS (Platform as a Service) Support
requirements.Description: Magellan must support HP’s PaaS offerings, enabling integration with cloud-based solutions and services.
requirements.Rationale: Aligns with HP’s strategic goals for PaaS acceleration and recurring revenue.
requirements.Dependencies: PaaS platform readiness and printer compatibility.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Magellan is certified for PaaS integration and supports all required APIs.

requirements.Title: Telemetry Requirements
requirements.Description: Implement telemetry features to monitor device health, usage, and proactively identify issues for Magellan printers.
requirements.Rationale: Enables predictive maintenance, supports quality assurance, and improves customer support.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Telemetry data is reliably collected and accessible for 99% of shipped devices.
